title: incident.json
description: Output of component B, the Incident Reader. Contract: docs/03-architecture.md section 3. [feed] = copied from the STN message by code. [code] = decided by code. [llm] = extracted by the model.

announced_at.description: [feed] ANNOUNCEMENT_DATE of this message, Hong Kong time (+08:00).

closed_at.description: Set from the incident timeline (component A2). The Reader sees one message, so it leaves this null.

district.description: [feed] DISTRICT_EN when present (it is usually empty), else null. Never guessed.

road_name.description: [llm] The road where the incident is, as its official English name, e.g. 'Aberdeen Tunnel'. null if the message names no road.

direction.description: [llm] Direction of travel affected, written as '<place> bound', e.g. 'Causeway Bay bound'. null if none is stated.

near_landmark.description: [llm] Landmark the incident is near, e.g. 'Wong Chuk Hang Hospital'. null if none is stated.

between_landmark.description: [llm] 'X and Y' when the message places the incident between two points. null otherwise.

lat.description: [feed] LATITUDE (WGS-84) when present, else null. The model never produces coordinates.

coords_source.description: [feed] 'source' when the feed gave coordinates, else 'none'. 'inferred_from_landmark' is reserved for a deterministic landmark lookup (not built yet).

lanes_closed.description: [llm] Lanes closed to traffic as of this message. ['unspecified'] when lanes are closed but the message does not say which ([E] decides what to simulate). 'all' and 'unspecified' stand alone. [] when no lane is closed, e.g. the lanes have re-opened.

lanes_total.description: [llm] Number of lanes in the affected direction, only if the message states it. null otherwise; never guessed from road knowledge.

in_scope.description: [code] True when the message names a road in CORRIDOR_ROAD_NAMES (src/loaders/corridor.py) and is not a public event or public transport notice.

confidence.description: [llm] The model's own confidence in this extraction. Always shown to the operator.

notes.description: [llm] Anything the operator should know: ambiguity, a field left null and why, a Chinese-only detail. Empty string if nothing.
